passages.text: Chief complaint: low back pain radiating down the left leg.
History: low back pain radiating to the left leg since early May 2026, about 8 weeks.
Treatment so far: completed 6 weeks of physical therapy and a naproxen trial with no meaningful improvement.
Neurologic exam: normal. No weakness, saddle anesthesia, history of cancer, or fever.
Assessment: lumbar radiculopathy with low back pain (M54.16, M54.50).
Plan: order MRI lumbar spine without contrast (CPT 72148).
